subject: Linguagens e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Utilizar as diversas linguagens (artísticas, corporais e verbais) em diferentes contextos, valorizando-as como fenômeno social, cultural, histórico, variável, heterogêneo e sensível aos contextos de uso.

components.description_pt: Usar linguagens artística, corporal e verbal adequadamente em diferentes contextos sociais
components.description_en: Use artistic, bodily, and verbal languages appropriately in different social contexts
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between formal and informal speech registers and select appropriately

components.description_pt: Reconhecer linguagens como fenômenos sociais, culturais e históricos
components.description_en: Recognize languages as social, cultural, and historical phenomena

components.description_pt: Explicar como linguagens variam e são heterogêneas em diferentes contextos
components.description_en: Explain how languages vary and are heterogeneous across different contexts
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how language functions differently across formal, informal, and technical contexts

components.description_pt: Analisar como o contexto influencia o uso de diferentes formas de linguagem
components.description_en: Analyze how context influences the use of different language forms
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how language functions differently across formal, informal, and technical contexts

cc_matches.description: Apply knowledge of language to understand how language functions in different contexts, to make effective choices for meaning or style, and to comprehend more fully when reading or listening.
Adapt speech to a variety of contexts and communicative tasks, demonstrating command of formal English when indicated or appropriate.
